account_name.description: The name on the account, as the bank holds it: yours.

account_number.description: The full number as your bank shows it, 6 to 17 digits; spaces and hyphens are dropped. Needed to prepare a change; left out when replacing a draft, the number saved before stays (unless the bank changes). Sealed on save, never logged or audited (SEC-11).

bic.description: The bank's SWIFT/BIC code, 8 or 11 characters: a bank in Singapore.
